CustomField.formula: IF( HOUR(QCC_Expected_Arrival_Time__c) <= 12, LPAD(TEXT(HOUR(QCC_Expected_Arrival_Time__c)), 2, '0'), LPAD(TEXT(HOUR(QCC_Expected_Arrival_Time__c) - 12), 2, '0') ) & ":" & LPAD(TEXT(MINUTE(QCC_Expected_Arrival_Time__c)), 2, '0') & IF ( HOUR(QCC_Expected_Arrival_Time__c) < 12, " AM", " PM" )
CustomField.label: QCC TECH Expected Arrival Time Formula
